tools.name: forage_search
tools.description: Search for MCP servers and tools across registries (Official MCP Registry, Smithery, npm). Describe what capability you need and get ranked results.

query.description: Natural language description of the capability you need (e.g. 'query postgres database', 'search slack messages', 'manage github issues')

sources.description: Which registries to search. Defaults to all.

tools.name: forage_evaluate
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific package — version, downloads, README summary, install command. Use this before installing to verify quality.

tools.name: forage_install
tools.description: Install an MCP server and start it as a proxied subprocess. The server's tools become available immediately via Forage — no restart needed. IMPORTANT: Set confirm=true to proceed with installation (user will be prompted to approve the tool call).

command.description: Command to run the server. Defaults to 'npx'.

args.description: Arguments for the command. Defaults to ['-y', packageName].

env.description: Environment variables to pass to the server process.

confirm.description: Must be true to proceed with installation. This is a safety gate — the user will see and approve the tool call.

tools.name: forage_learn
tools.description: Write usage instructions for an installed tool to agent rule files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules/). This persists knowledge across sessions so the agent remembers how to use the tool next time.

toolName.description: Name of the tool (as shown in forage_status)

rules.description: Markdown-formatted usage instructions for the agent. Include: when to use the tool, key commands/patterns, any required env vars or config.

target.description: Specific file path to write to. If omitted, auto-detects based on which agent is in use.

tools.name: forage_status
tools.description: List all tools that Forage has installed and is currently proxying. Shows which servers are running, what tools they provide, and their install status.

tools.name: forage_uninstall
tools.description: Remove a previously installed tool. Stops the server, removes from manifest, and cleans up agent rules. Set confirm=true to proceed.

name.description: Name of the installed tool to remove (as shown in forage_status)

confirm.description: Must be true to proceed with uninstallation.
